name: flora_monthly_64m_line
description: Derived by hand from flora 6.7.1, 6.4.2 and 6.10.4 (test 38 of 16; FQ15). A 2048 m city (128 x 128 cells). Block (bx, bz) queries cells (2bx, 2bz)..(2bx + 1, 2bz + 1), the world box (32bx + 0.1, 32bz + 0.1) .. (32bx + 31.9, 32bz + 31.9), through the occupant manager's 64 m index. Occupant 1, type A (half-width 9) at (1726.9807, 328.84396): box z 319.84396 .. 337.84396, listed from z 319.94396 (z cell 69), so blocks (53, 10) and (54, 10) return it and blocks (53, 9) and (54, 9) (z 288.1 .. 319.9, z cell 68 only) do not, although they overlap it. Occupant 2, type A at (1726.9807, 328.8): box z from 319.8, listed from 319.9 (z cell 68): all four blocks. Occupant 3, type B (half-width 0.4, a box 0.8 m wide, no inset) at (1726.9807, 320.26): box z 319.86 .. 320.66 listed from z cell 68, x 1726.58 .. 1727.38: blocks (53, 9) and (53, 10). A month that visits only block (53, 9) (propagation off, no seeds, today 5000, every occupant born on day 1000, lifespan 1460) rebirths occupants 2 and 3 and leaves occupant 1's birth date and state unchanged; a month that visits only block (53, 10) then rebirths occupant 1.
